title: Residential Tenancies Act
verified_how: Register index entry 'Residential Tenancies Act', consolidation date June 24, 2026 (the most recently consolidated of the Acts listed here). Cover page prints 'RESIDENTIAL TENANCIES ACT / RSNWT 1988,c.R-5' (French: 'LOI SUR LA LOCATION DES LOCAUX D'HABITATION / LRTNO 1988, ch. R-5'), amended from RSNWT 1988,c.8(Supp) (in force July 19, 1993; SI-008-93) through SNWT 2015,c.8 and later. Standard office-consolidation notice; not marked repealed. Administering department per the October 13, 2025 table: Justice.
notes: Rent, deposits, repairs, termination and the Rental Officer's jurisdiction. The general consumer-protection statute for the same topic is the Consumer Protection Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c.C-17 (consolidation date April 2, 2025, verified on the same register), with the Cost of Credit Disclosure Act and Sale of Goods Act alongside it; only one Act is listed per topic, and tenancy was chosen as the more consequential everyday statute.
